Size Chart - Tank Top

Scarlet Ruffle is made for cheerful mother-daughter moments, from beach photos to warm-weather brunches and vacation strolls. The vivid red ruffle tank top gives the look its bright focal point while staying easy to pair with your own shorts, skirts, or pants.
This listing is for the tank top only. The size table uses the supplied strap and opening measurements; unavailable bust, hip, and total garment-length values are intentionally not estimated.
Key Features:
Tank top only:
Includes the red ruffle top; bottoms and styling pieces shown in photos are not included.
Mother-daughter sizing:
Includes girl and mother rows only where the vendor chart provides measurements.
Adjustable straps:
Strap measurements are copied from the attached size chart.
Ruffle cami shape:
Bright red layered ruffles create a photo-ready summer style.
Easy outfit pairing:
Style it with your own beach pants, denim shorts, skirts, or vacation basics.
Choose each size to build a coordinated red mommy-and-me top moment for the next sunny day together.
Fabric:
95% cotton, based on the verified product details.
Family story:
A sporty matching tee for moms, dads, girls, and boys, easy for casual outings, park days, birthdays, and family photos.
Print reference:
Red Heart Raglan pairs a white tee body with red contrast sleeves, sleeve stripes, and a small heart accent.
Design details:

Short sleeves, crew neckline, relaxed raglan tee shape, and one shared red-and-white colorway for children, moms, and dads. Skirts, shorts, shoes, sunglasses, and outdoor props shown in photos are styling only.
Care:
Machine wash cold on gentle, turn inside out, line dry or tumble low, and avoid bleach.
Size range:
Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years, Mother S through Mother 2XL, and Father M through Father 3XL.
Size Chart - Shirt

Red Heart Raglan is a clean family matching tee that feels playful without being overly dressed up. The red contrast sleeves and small heart detail make the coordinated look easy to spot in photos while still pairing simply with denim, shorts, or casual skirts.

The source selector includes separate tops, bottoms, and complete suits; this draft intentionally lists only the chart-backed top variants because the product category resolves to T-shirts and the supplied measurements support the tops most cleanly. Bottoms and suit selector values remain unlisted until a separate bottom/set request confirms the exact variant model.
Key Features:
One coordinated tee:
Same red-and-white short-sleeve shirt look for child, mom, and dad sizes.
Cotton feel:
The vendor detail page identifies a 95% cotton main fabric composition.
Family-friendly range:
Child sizes from 90 through 150, mom sizes from S through 2XL, and dad sizes from M through 3XL.
Photo-ready color:
Red raglan sleeves, striped sleeve bands, and the heart accent make the matching look easy to spot.
Chart-backed variants:
Every size option is backed by a row from the attached vendor chart.
Choose the child, mom, and dad sizes you need to build an easy red-heart matching look for everyday family memories.

Size Chart - Two-Piece Set

Red Resort is a clean, cheerful mommy-and-me outfit built around a red tee and white pleated skirt. The look feels polished in photos while staying casual enough for sunny walks, park days, and vacation memories.

The vendor evidence provides a top measurement chart, a skirt measurement chart for numeric skirt sizes, and a seller selector showing the complete set sizes. The skirt chart rows 110-150 are shown where they match the selector; adult skirt measurements are left unavailable because no S-2XL skirt chart was supplied.
Key Features:
Complete outfit:
Each size includes both the red top and the white pleated skirt.
Mother-daughter styling:
Each selection includes one red tee and one white pleated skirt for one person.
Chart-backed rows:
Every variant is backed by the seller selector; skirt measurements appear only where the supplied skirt chart matches the selector size.
Photo-ready palette:
Bright red and clean white are simple to coordinate for beach and resort outfits.
Choose your sizes:
Select mother and child sizes separately for your matching outfits.

Family story:
A sunny mom-and-daughter look for garden walks, vacations, picnics, and warm-weather family photos.
Print reference:
Golden Daisy pairs a mustard-yellow sleeveless top with white
daisy embroidery and ivory wide-leg pants with tonal floral cutwork.
Design details:
Choose the top or pants separately. The top has a relaxed sleeveless swing shape; the pants have a pull-on waist and easy wide-leg drape.
Care:
Machine wash cold on gentle, turn inside out, line dry, and avoid bleach.
Size range:
Top in Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years and Mother S-L; pants in Child 1-2 Years through Child 9-10 Years and Mother S-L.
Size Chart - Top and Pants

Golden Daisy is a cheerful mommy-and-me outfit story built from two coordinated separates. The yellow sleeveless top brings the bright daisy moment, while the ivory pants add soft texture and an easy wide-leg silhouette for summer photos.

The attached chart publishes YC8970 as the top and YC8971 as the pants, so this draft keeps the shopper picker honest with a Type choice. The size guide is keyed to the same child and mother size labels shoppers select, with dashes where a piece is not charted in that size.
Key Features:
Separate piece picker:
Type options let shoppers choose the top or pants instead of assuming a bundled set.
Mother-daughter sizing:
Chart-backed child and mother rows only; no dad or boy rows were invented.
Photo-ready palette:
Mustard yellow and ivory make the matching look bright, soft, and easy to style.
Summer silhouettes:
Sleeveless swing top and wide-leg pants keep the look breezy.
Chart-backed variants:
Every Shopify variant maps back to a visible YC8970 or YC8971 size row.
Choose the pieces and sizes you need to build a golden matching look for your next sunny day together.

Family story:
A coordinated mom-and-daughter beach set made for warm vacations, resort mornings, and sunny matching photos.
Print:
Crochet keeps the look clean and coastal with a textured openwork pattern in Black, White, Orange, Apricot, or Green.
Design details:
Sleeveless V-neck styling, open-knit texture, ribbed waist detail, and matching skirt silhouette for both mom and daughter.
Care:
Hand wash cold, reshape gently, dry flat in the shade, and avoid bleach or rough poolside surfaces.
Size range:
Girls Child 6-8 Years to Child 10-12 Years; Mother S to Mother XL.
Size Chart - Beach Coverup Set

The Crochet Mommy and Me Set brings a polished beach-coverup moment to mother-daughter matching. The sleeveless open-knit top and skirt styling gives the outfit a breezy resort feel while keeping the look soft, simple, and easy to photograph.

Use it over swimwear for beach walks, resort breakfasts, and vacation portraits, or style it with sandals and woven accessories for warm-weather family outings. The chart-backed size range covers three girls' sizes and four mother sizes, with each variant tied to a row from the attached chart.
Key Features:
Open-knit crochet texture:
Airy patterning gives the set its coastal coverup look.
Mom + daughter match:
Same textured styling across girls' and mother sizes.
Beach-ready silhouette:
Sleeveless V-neck top and skirt-style bottom shown in the supplied product image.
Chart-backed sizing:
Girls' sizes use age, height, bust, waist, and length guidance; mother sizes use bust, hip, and length.
Five color choices:
Choose Black, White, Orange, Apricot, or Green for the same chart-backed coverup set.
Choose each size and pack a clean matching beach look for your next sunny family memory.

The Sky Blue Family Matching Set creates one easy coordinated outfit story across parents and kids. The dresses bring a breezy pleated shape for mother-daughter photos, while the matching shirts keep dad and son in the same soft blue palette.

Use the chart-backed height, weight, bust, waist, sleeve, and length guidance to choose each family member's size. The listing includes only the dress and shirt pieces supported by the attached size chart; shorts shown in the lifestyle photo are intentionally excluded.
Key Features:
Full-family matching:
Dress options for mom and girls, shirt options for dad and boys.
Sky-blue palette:
Soft color story made for sunny photos, pool days, and beach trips.

No shorts included:

The Sunshine Daisy Family Matching Set is made for beach trips, sunny family photos, vacation dinners, and coordinated warm-weather celebrations. The dress side keeps the girls' and moms' look sweet and photo-ready, while the boys' and dads' shirt keeps the matching moment relaxed and easy.

This draft follows the attached chart closely: dress variants are created for girls and mothers, and shirt variants are created for boys and fathers. The source chart also publishes shorts measurements on the male rows, but shorts are excluded from this listing per the operator request.

Vacation-ready daisy look:

Family story:
A mom-and-daughter skirt match made for birthdays, portraits, special outings, and playful dress-up days.
Print:

Full layered tulle silhouette, pull-on waist styling, and a twirl-friendly shape for both mother and child.

Size Chart - Tulle Skirt

The Pink & Blue Tulle Mommy and Me Skirts listing keeps the matching moment simple: choose a child size, choose a mother size, and select the pastel color that fits the photo plan. The supplied imagery shows the same soft layered skirt idea for mom and daughter, with pink and blue options available from the same source.

The attached chart supports the published size rows and adult fit guidance. It does not publish skirt waist, hip, or skirt-length measurements, so those cells stay blank in the table instead of being guessed.

Mom + daughter match:
Coordinated skirt styling across child and mother sizes.
Two color choices:

Twirl-friendly tulle look:
